timeline.text: I drive the same region every day, but never the same route — any fixed-itinerary app breaks by day two.
I wanted to actually learn these places, in Norwegian and Ukrainian, without staring at my phone.
Now a companion rides along, turning real local-history facts into short stories with Claude — like a friend narrating the drive.
It reacts to wherever I am, not to any planned route.
And it never speaks without two solid sourced facts behind it.
